arStrings.szText: Only what he did to himself. When his predecessor, the wise and benevolent Khalim, was cut down by the Zakarum High Council, it was Sankekur who struck the first blow.
For he and his cohorts had committed themselves to serve Mephisto, the Lord of Hatred, and rule the Zakarum faith on his behalf.
So they butchered Khalim, took the mitre of leadership from his corpse, and placed it on Sankekur’s head, empowering him to spread Mephisto’s corruption throughout the East.
Yet, that was not enough for Mephisto. He soon took Sankekur as his mortal vessel, and through him set about the corruption of all humanity...until some friends of mine stepped in his way.
